name: Entity Repository
description: Provides base repository services which can be extended.
project_description: Provides base repository services which can be extended. This module won't do much by itself. It supplies abstract/base repository classes (EntityRepository, NodeRepository, TaxonomyTermRepository, CommentRepository) registered as parent services, so entity queries live in named, injectable services instead of being copied through controllers, blocks and forms. Extend a base class (or reuse it via setBundles/setVocabularies) to constrain results to specific bundles/vocabularies and add domain-specific query methods. The base classes provide findAll(), findBy(), countBy(), countBaseQuery() and loadByIds(), each running an entity query with access checking enabled and an access tag added. A separate entity_repository_example submodule demonstrates the pattern with a news content type.
